final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_telescope), kept AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_telescope AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg), mean_diff AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM kept) SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_mod, k.diff, k.avg_mod / m.avg_diff AS ratio FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN mean_diff AS m ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10.
